notes.title: Malfunction 1.6.0 now available + Demo update
notes.notes:
[h1][b]Malfunction 1.6.0 is currently now available to play![/b][/h1]


With this update you'll notice that the entire menu has been completely overhauled.


[h1][b]Check it out for yourself![/b][/h1]

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/29370169/743674e71fbc61a2e06b30b76cb8ad044d931cb5.png[/img]

[b]As you can see, the menu has been designed to look and feel more smooth and responsive. 

With all of the modes given below, all you need to do is click ONCE and you're in![/b]



[h1][b]While it is nice to have less menu's, it is VERY essential to have the option to choose which chapter you'd like to jump into.[/b][/h1]

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/29370169/bbd55eb6637143e31f5d6368fcadd5b90a789adc.png[/img]

[b]We've decided that a more solid experience would be to simply play through each chapter rather than choosing each individual area to spawn. This is all about getting in the game quicker, after all.[/b]



[h1][b]The options menu has been changed for the better as well! Anything you see and read here is pretty much common sense.[/b][/h1]

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/29370169/87f06bf7f2ab5006e9dd48499db487f6df323745.png[/img]

[b]The pause menu shares the same menu as well. It might take a little while to get used to, but once you do, it's a lot more fluid and responsive![/b]



You can check out the rest of the features within the actual game itself.

[h1][b]The demo version has been updated as well![/b][/h1]
So if you were still skeptical about the game but didn't feel like playing an outdated version, it's all up to date now! Give it a shot!

As always, have yourselves a nice day!

notes.title: Malfunction 1.5.1 Update and -80% off!
notes.notes:
Hello! Very short announcement here.

[h1]First[/h1] [b][u]Malfunction has received another update (1.5.1)[/u][/b] which fixes many glitches regarding the menu/s and also adds splash screens when launching the game. (When other minor fixes or additions are implemented in the future, you can expect them to drop in the 1.5.1 update list)

[h1]Second[/h1] I'd like to say that I am working really hard on a new project called 'Hectic' and you'll hear more about that very soon. Just to give you a quick reference, the game will be an FPS that plans to introduce many unique elements.

[h1]Third[/h1] [b][u]Malfunction is also -80% for a limited time.[/u][/b] So grab it while you can!


Stay tuned for further updates!

notes.title: Malfunction Content Update & -50% off!
notes.notes:
[h1][b]Malfunction is back with it's latest update (1.5.0) which includes many additions. Let's list them here![/b][/h1]


[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/29370169/e8298ba7fa72e94bd70c3d136d12ade2927f52eb.png[/img]

[b]Freezing Rocks is a brand new Obstruction scenario that throws every enemy of all factions towards the player (Quite literally at the same time). Bosses are MUCH more common on Freezing Rocks as well as all other Scenarios available for Obstruction. Get prepared, because it's quite a challenge![/b]

[b][u](Several Steam achievements have also been added for Obstruction)[/u][/b]



[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/29370169/c57cab4db82cd8cceea9f5d8c149b79aa97eafe5.png[/img]

[b]Plague Valley is an additional course to the game mode 'Viper Rush'. Within this course, you'll be rushing through the freezing winds as well as plagued areas to collect as many goals as you can.[/b]

[b][u](Steam achievements have been added for the game mode)[/u][/b]



[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/29370169/2c084c9f014c8b37d95d089d5fd9f60b804ed0d4.png[/img]

[b]Obelisk Cache is a new scene for Stealth Attack that throws the player into ancient Pound temples, as Pounds themselves patrol the area/s. Don't get caught, or else that's an automatic failure![/b]

[b][u](Steam achievements have been added for Stealth Attack)[/u][/b]

[h1]There has also been some other changes such as HUGE improvements for all the menus. You are now always able to select everything being displayed on-screen.[/h1]


[h1][b][u]To celebrate the update's arrival, Malfunction is also -50% for an entire week! so be sure to grab the game if you haven't yet.[/u][/b][/h1]


[h1]Anyways, that's all for now. Enjoy the update![/h1]

notes.title: Malfunction 1.4.0 Content Update
notes.notes:
[h1][b]Malfunction has just received it's latest update, which includes new game modes! Let's list them here![/b][/h1]


[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/29370169/59a037f67f2067a3c9abaa6b549722f75be93723.png[/img]

[b]Viper rush is a game mode that requires you to collect as many goals as you can before the timer expires. The game mode has Steam achievements as well as 2 courses. More will be added at a later time.[/b]


[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/29370169/9fcf244e4dcbd992f51a33bcab02b9680968cf87.png[/img]

[b]Stealth Attack is an additional game mode that puts you in the shoes of Barloc, who must stealth attack as many enemies as possible before getting caught. If you're spotted, that's an automatic failure. The game mode also includes 2 maps and several Steam achievements as well.[/b]



I also wanted to say thank you all so much for considering checking out Malfunction. I can almost guarantee you that you will definitely be seeing more content updates similar to these in the future.


[h1][b]Stay tuned for more future updates![/b][/h1]

notes.title: Malfunction Demo + Update!
notes.notes:
[h1][b]If you wanted to try Malfunction for free, now you're able to with the Malfunction Demo![/b][/h1] It is available right now and includes a single playable chapter for free.

For the full version owners, there has also been some BIG hotfix updates, containing many fixes/changes. One of the most notable features is the latest addition; profiles!

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/29370169/2d143b61445373598447579ebf616a3c7ae68200.png[/img]

With the profiles, you're now able to save ALL progress, whether it be from your stats of Obstruction, or all of your progress/materials of the campaign, it is now all saveable and can still be accessed with every latest update.

[h1][u]Did you have any previous saves before the profile/s were added?[/u][/h1] They should still be there, simply create your profile with 'Profile 01', and all of your custom saves/checkpoints should still exist.


Anyways, thank you all so much for checking out Malfunction and giving it chance. More updates are coming soon!
